name: Disaar Sunscreen Lotion 50gm Max Sun 90+ SPF PA+++ 8 Hour Protect
description:
Disaar Sunscreen Lotion 50g Max Sun 90+ SPF PA+++ | 8-Hour Protection | Made in China

Shield your skin from intense sun exposure with Disaar Sunscreen Lotion Max Sun 90+ SPF PA+++. This high-protection sunscreen is enriched with plant extracts and antioxidants, offering broad-spectrum defense against UVA and UVB rays while keeping your skin hydrated and healthy.

Key Features:

SPF & PA Rating: SPF 90+ PA+++ for maximum sun protection

8-Hour Protection: Long-lasting defense against sunburn and skin damage

Skin Benefits: Strengthens skin defenses, smooths cells, improves elasticity, and helps prevent wrinkles and fine lines

Hydrating Formula: Keeps skin moisturized while providing sun protection

Ingredients: Enriched with plant extracts and antioxidants

Weight: 50g

Origin: Made in China

Protect your skin from sun damage, premature aging, and dryness with Disaar Sunscreen Lotion Max Sun 90+ SPF PA+++.
